primary_meaning: The four living creatures of Ezekiel and Revelation symbolize the four Evangelists (or the four Gospels): man/angel for Matthew, lion for Mark, ox for Luke, and eagle for John.

alternatives.meaning: Cherubim (angelic throne guardians) who continually worship God and execute His will
The totality of animate creation (or the four corners/orders of creation) offering perpetual praise to God
Four attributes or faces of Christ (royal power as lion, sacrificial service as ox, perfect humanity as man, soaring divinity as eagle)
Simply ordinary animals or living beings without special apocalyptic symbolism (as in creation or flood narratives)

notes: The Gospel/Evangelist association is the most widespread symbolic reading in historic Christian teaching, liturgy, and iconography (rooted in Irenaeus and later Fathers). Biblical scholarship primarily identifies the figures as cherubim, while the creation-praise and Christ-attributes readings are also standard complementary layers. No major competing symbolic system has displaced these.
